fire_response.title: Fire & Explosion Response
fire_response.step_exit_desc: Locate emergency exit. Face the green arrow.
fire_response.step_extinguisher_desc: Aim at the base of the 3D fire. Tap to aim, then confirm.
fire_response.step_evacuate_desc: What is the correct action after using extinguisher?
fire_response.complete_desc: All checkpoints fired. Assessment engine will score your attempt.

gas_leak.title: Gas Leak & Confined Space Protocol
gas_leak.step_hazard_desc: Identify marked toxic/confined gas perimeter in AR space.
gas_leak.step_ppe_desc: Select all required PPE for hazardous gas entry:
gas_leak.step_buddy_desc: What is the safety attendant role outside the confined opening?
gas_leak.buddy_standby_lifeline: Standby outside opening with continuous communication & lifeline
gas_leak.buddy_both_enter: Both workers enter confined space together to work faster
gas_leak.buddy_leaves_tools: Buddy leaves area to fetch spare tools from workshop
gas_leak.buddy_enter_alone: Enter alone first, buddy follows only if alarms sound
gas_leak.complete_desc: All gas protocol checkpoints fired. Assessment engine will score your attempt.
